verses.zh: 他们必牵着牛羊去寻求耶和华，却寻不见；他已经转去离开他们。

verses.en: They are unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.
verses.zh: 他们向耶和华行事诡诈，生了私子。到了月朔，他们与他们的地业必被吞灭。

verses.en: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!
verses.zh: 你们当在基比亚吹角，在拉玛吹号，在伯・亚文吹出大声，说：便雅悯哪，有仇敌在你后头！

words.g: in + Ramah, the name of four places in Palestine

verses.en: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.
verses.zh: 在责罚的日子，以法莲必变为荒场；我在以色列支派中，指示将来必成的事。

verses.en: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.
verses.zh: 犹大的首领如同挪移地界的人，我必将忿怒倒在他们身上，如水一般。

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.
verses.zh: 以法莲因乐从人的命令，就受欺压，被审判压碎。

words.g: to crack in pieces, literally or figuratively

verses.en: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.
verses.zh: 我使以法莲如虫蛀之物，使犹大家如朽烂之木。

words.g: to + Ephrajim, a son of Joseph
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to King Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.
verses.zh: 以法莲见自己有病，犹大见自己有伤，他们就打发人往亚述去见耶雷布王，他却不能医治你们，不能治好你们的伤。

words.g: and + Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
Ashshur, the second son of Shem
Jareb, a symbolical name for Assyria
to + to mend , i.e.  to cure

verses.en: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.
verses.zh: 我必向以法莲如狮子，向犹大家如少壮狮子。我必撕裂而去，我要夺去，无人搭救。

words.g: to + Ephrajim, a son of Joseph
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”
verses.zh: 我要回到原处，等他们自觉有罪（或译：承认己罪），寻求我面；他们在急难的时候必切切寻求我。

words.g: to dawn, i.e.  be  early at any task + +me/my

verses.en: “Come! Let’s return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.
verses.zh: 来吧，我们归向耶和华！他撕裂我们，也必医治；他打伤我们，也必缠裹。

words.g: and + to mend , i.e.  to cure + +us/our

verses.en: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.
verses.zh: 过两天他必使我们苏醒，第三天他必使我们兴起，我们就在他面前得以存活。

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively + +us/our
and + to live, whether literally or figuratively

verses.en: Let’s acknowledge the LORD. Let’s press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, the LORD will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”
verses.zh: 我们务要认识耶和华，竭力追求认识他。他出现确如晨光；他必临到我们像甘雨，像滋润田地的春雨。

words.g: a going forth, i.e.  an egress + +him/his/it

verses.en: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early.
verses.zh: 主说：以法莲哪，我可向你怎样行呢？犹大啊，我可向你怎样做呢？因为你们的良善如同早晨的云雾，又如速散的甘露。

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
like + a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud
to load up , i.e. to start early in the morning

verses.en: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.
verses.zh: 因此，我藉先知砍伐他们，以我口中的话杀戮他们；我施行的审判如光发出。

words.g: in + a prophet or  inspired man
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.zh: 我喜爱良善（或译：怜恤），不喜爱祭祀；喜爱认识神，胜于燔祭。

verses.en: But they, like Adam, have broken the covenant. They were unfaithful to me there.
verses.zh: 他们却如亚当背约，在境内向我行事诡诈。

words.g: like + Adam the name of the first man, also of a place in Palestine

verses.en: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.
verses.zh: 基列是作孽之人的城，被血沾染。

words.g: Gilad, a region East of the Jordan
to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem, committing shameful crimes.
verses.zh: 强盗成群，怎样埋伏杀人，祭司结党，也照样在示剑的路上杀戮，行了邪恶。

words.g: to dash in pieces, i.e. kill
a plan, especially a bad one

verses.en: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Ephraim. Israel is defiled.
verses.zh: 在以色列家，我见了可憎的事；在以法莲那里有淫行，以色列被玷污。

words.g: to + Ephrajim, a son of Joseph
to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense

verses.en: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.
verses.zh: 犹大啊，我使被掳之民归回的时候，必有为你所命定的收场。

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.
verses.zh: 我想医治以色列的时候，以法莲的罪孽和撒马利亚的罪恶就显露出来。他们行事虚谎，内有贼人入室偷窃，外有强盗成群骚扰。

words.g: like + to mend , i.e.  to cure + +me/my
to do or make , especially to practise
in + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.en: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.
verses.zh: 他们心里并不思想我记念他们的一切恶；他们所行的现在缠绕他们，都在我面前。

verses.en: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.zh: 他们行恶使君王欢喜，说谎使首领喜乐。

words.g: and + in + a failure of flesh, i.e. emaciation + +them/their

verses.en: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.
verses.zh: 他们都是行淫的，像火炉被烤饼的烧热，从抟面到发面的时候，暂不使火着旺。

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as
from + to cook, especially to bake
to repose, i.e. desist from exertion

verses.en: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.
verses.zh: 在我们王宴乐的日子，首领因酒的烈性成病；王与亵慢人拉手。

words.g: to draw, used in a great variety of applications

verses.en: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their anger smolders all night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.
verses.zh: 首领埋伏的时候，心中热如火炉，就如烤饼的整夜睡卧，到了早晨火气炎炎。

verses.en: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.
verses.zh: 众民也热如火炉，烧灭他们的官长。他们的君王都仆倒而死；他们中间无一人求告我。

verses.en: Ephraim mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.
verses.zh: 以法莲与列邦人搀杂；以法莲是没有翻过的饼。

verses.en: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.
verses.zh: 外邦人吞吃他劳力得来的，他却不知道；头发斑白，他也不觉得。

verses.en: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to the LORD their God, nor sought him, for all this.
verses.zh: 以色列的骄傲当面见证自己，虽遭遇这一切，他们仍不归向耶和华―他们的神，也不寻求他。

verses.en: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.
verses.zh: 以法莲好像鸽子愚蠢无知；他们求告埃及，投奔亚述。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
Ashshur, the second son of Shem

verses.en: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
verses.zh: 他们去的时候，我必将我的网撒在他们身上；我要打下他们，如同空中的鸟。我必按他们会众所听见的惩罚他们。

words.g: like + something heard, i.e. a sound

verses.en: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
verses.zh: 他们因离弃我，必定有祸；因违背我，必被毁灭。我虽要救赎他们，他们却向我说谎。

verses.en: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.
verses.zh: 他们并不诚心哀求我，乃在床上呼号；他们为求五谷新酒聚集，仍然悖逆我。

words.g: to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn

verses.en: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.
verses.zh: 我虽教导他们，坚固他们的膀臂，他们竟图谋抗拒我。

verses.en: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.zh: 他们归向，却不归向至上者；他们如同翻背的弓。他们的首领必因舌头的狂傲倒在刀下；这在埃及地必作人的讥笑。

words.g: like + a bow, forshooting  or the iris
from + strictly froth at the mouth, i.e.  fury
Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt

verses.en: “Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over the LORD’s house, because they have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.
verses.zh: 你用口吹角吧！敌人如鹰来攻打耶和华的家；因为这民违背我的约，干犯我的律法。

words.g: the palate or inside of the mouth + +you/your

verses.en: They cry to me, ‘My God, we, Israel, acknowledge you!’
verses.zh: 他们必呼叫我说：我的神啊，我们以色列认识你了。

verses.en: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.
verses.zh: 以色列丢弃良善（或译：福分）；仇敌必追逼他。

verses.en: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.zh: 他们立君王，却不由我；他们立首领，我却不认。他们用金银为自己制造偶像，以致被剪除。

verses.en: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?
verses.zh: 撒马利亚啊，耶和华已经丢弃你的牛犊；我的怒气向拜牛犊的人发作。他们到几时方能无罪呢？

words.g: a  calf , especially one nearly grown + +you/your

verses.en: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
verses.zh: 这牛犊出于以色列，是匠人所造的，并不是神。撒马利亚的牛犊必被打碎。

words.g: a  calf , especially one nearly grown

verses.en: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.
verses.zh: 他们所种的是风，所收的是暴风；所种的不成禾稼，就是发苗也不结实；即便结实，外邦人必吞吃。

words.g: something that rises, i.e. a stalk of grain

verses.en: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.
verses.zh: 以色列被吞吃；现今在列国中，好像人不喜悦的器皿。

verses.en: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.
verses.zh: 他们投奔亚述，如同独行的野驴；以法莲贿买朋党。

words.g: Ashshur, the second son of Shem

verses.en: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones.
verses.zh: 他们虽在列邦中贿买人，现在我却要聚集惩罚他们；他们因君王和首领所加的重担日渐衰微。

words.g: and + to bore, i.e.  to wound

verses.en: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.
verses.zh: 以法莲增添祭坛取罪；因此，祭坛使他犯罪。

verses.en: I wrote for him the many things of my law, but they were regarded as a strange thing.
verses.zh: 我为他写了律法万条，他却以为与他毫无关涉。

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice meat and eat it, but the LORD doesn’t accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.
verses.zh: 至于献给我的祭物，他们自食其肉，耶和华却不悦纳他们。现在必记念他们的罪孽，追讨他们的罪恶；他们必归回埃及。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt

verses.en: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire on his cities, and it will devour its fortresses.”
verses.zh: 以色列忘记造他的主，建造宫殿；犹大多造坚固城，我却要降火焚烧他的城邑，烧灭其中的宫殿。

words.g: and + to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of
and + Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: Don’t rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor.
verses.zh: 以色列啊，不要像外邦人欢喜快乐；因为你行邪淫离弃你的神，在各谷场上如妓女喜爱赏赐。

verses.en: The threshing floor and the wine press won’t feed them, and the new wine will fail her.
verses.zh: 谷场和酒榨都不够以色列人使用；新酒也必缺乏。

words.g: to be untrue, in word  or deed

verses.en: They won’t dwell in the LORD’s land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.
verses.zh: 他们必不得住耶和华的地；以法莲却要归回埃及，必在亚述吃不洁净的食物。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
and + in + Ashshur, the second son of Shem

verses.en: They won’t pour out wine offerings to the LORD, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of it will be polluted; for their bread will be for their appetite. It will not come into the LORD’s house.
verses.zh: 他们必不得向耶和华奠酒，即便奠酒也不蒙悦纳。他们的祭物必如居丧者的食物，凡吃的必被玷污；因他们的食物只为自己的口腹，必不奉入耶和华的殿。

words.g: to pour out, especially a libation
to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense

verses.en: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
verses.zh: 在大会的日子，到耶和华的节期，你们怎样行呢？

words.g: a festival, or a victim therefor

verses.en: For, behold, when they flee destruction, Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver. Thorns will be in their tents.
verses.zh: 看哪，他们逃避灾难；埃及人必收殓他们的尸首，摩弗人必葬埋他们的骸骨。他们用银子做的美物上必长蒺藜；他们的帐棚中必生荆棘。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
Moph, the capital of Lower Egypt

verses.en: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.
verses.zh: 以色列人必知道降罚的日子临近，报应的时候来到。民说：作先知的是愚昧；受灵感的是狂妄，皆因他们多多作孽，大怀怨恨。

words.g: the + a prophet or  inspired man

verses.en: A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God. A fowler’s snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.
verses.zh: 以法莲曾作我神守望的；至于先知，在他一切的道上作为捕鸟人的网罗，在他神的家中怀怨恨。

words.g: to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance

verses.en: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them for their sins.
verses.zh: 以法莲深深地败坏，如在基比亚的日子一样。耶和华必记念他们的罪孽，追讨他们的罪恶。

verses.en: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season; but they came to Baal Peor, and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.
verses.zh: 主说：我遇见以色列如葡萄在旷野；我看见你们的列祖如无花果树上春季初熟的果子。他们却来到巴力・毗珥专拜那可羞耻的，就成为可憎恶的，与他们所爱的一样。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your
and + to hold aloof, i.e.  abstain )

verses.en: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception.
verses.zh: 至于以法莲人，他们的荣耀必如鸟飞去，必不生产，不怀胎，不成孕。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +them/their

verses.zh: 纵然养大儿女，我却必使他们丧子，甚至不留一个。我离弃他们，他们就有祸了。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + to miscarry, i.e. suffer abortion + +them/their

verses.en: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer.
verses.zh: 我看以法莲如泰尔栽于美地。以法莲却要将自己的儿女带出来，交与行杀戮的人。

words.g: to + Tsor, a place in Palestine
and + Ephrajim, a son of Joseph

verses.en: Give them—LORD what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你加给他们―加甚么呢？要使他们胎坠乳干。

words.g: and + the breast of a woman or animal

verses.en: “All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds, I will drive them out of my house! I will love them no more. All their princes are rebels.
verses.zh: 耶和华说：他们一切的恶事都在吉甲；我在那里憎恶他们。因他们所行的恶，我必从我地上赶出他们去，不再怜爱他们；他们的首领都是悖逆的。

words.g: in + Gilgal, the name of three places in Palestine
to turn away, i.e.  be refractory

verses.en: Ephraim is struck. Their root has dried up. They will bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb.”
verses.zh: 以法莲受责罚，根本枯干，必不能结果，即或生产，我必杀他们所生的爱子。

verses.en: My God will cast them away, because they didn’t listen to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations.
verses.zh: 我的神必弃绝他们，因为他们不听从他；他们也必飘流在列国中。

verses.en: Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit. According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars. As their land has prospered, they have adorned their sacred stones.
verses.zh: 以色列是茂盛的葡萄树，结果繁多。果子越多，就越增添祭坛；地土越肥美，就越造美丽的柱像。

words.g: to pour out, i.e. to empty
something stationed, i.e. a column or

verses.en: Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred stones.
verses.zh: 他们心怀二意，现今要定为有罪。耶和华必拆毁他们的祭坛，毁坏他们的柱像。

words.g: something stationed, i.e. a column or + +them/their
